name: Xata

evidence.sql: C02: managed SQL database is the primary type; D01: unmodified PostgreSQL 14 to 18
evidence.vector: V01: catalog lists pgvector 0.8.1 with HNSW and IVFFlat indexes

line: Managed PostgreSQL with copy-on-write branches, scale-to-zero and migration tools.

free.text: 14d trial; limits unset; may end early; if unpaid, delete 7d after trial end

cells.regions: AWS US/EU; GCP US and Asia-Southeast

sql.math: US price reference: 2 micro instances × 730 hours × $0.012 an hour + $0.28 × 1 billable GB = $17.80. This assumes one micro replica and 1 billable GB. Transfer, backup, tax and the total are unknown.

Assumes the branch is hibernated (asleep) all 730 hours: no compute. 1 billable GB × $0.28 = $0.28. If it starts active when idle, the default 30-minute delay adds $0.012. Backup, tax and other charges are unknown.

files.math: Xata Postgres is not a general file-storage service.

jobs.math: pg_cron runs SQL inside the database. No matching price for a 0.5 vCPU and 0.5 GB application worker is published.
